description: Show the signed-in user a short form, right in the chat, for setting up their estate in SwiftProbate. Submitting it builds their personalized probate checklist (the same as complete_onboarding, without asking the questions one by one). Use this when the user agrees to set up an estate, for example after list_my_estates shows they have none, or when they ask for help with their own situation (what to do for a specific person's estate, their next steps as executor) and have no estate yet. Do not use it for general probate questions, which the reference tools answer, or when the user already has an estate set up (use get_tasks instead). The result says whether the user has agreed to SwiftProbate's Terms on the website and whether an estate is already set up; the form shows the right screen for each case. If the form can't be shown in this chat, ask the setup questions conversationally and call complete_onboarding instead. SwiftProbate is software that helps people organize the probate process; it is not a law firm and does not give legal advice.
name: show_estate_setup
